transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming. Can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?
I don't know. Just... I hardly eat right anymore, I guess. Some days it's just coffee, maybe a piece of bread. My pants are hanging loose on me now. So... yeah.
When you're eating less, is it because you're trying to avoid gaining weight or because you just don't feel hungry or interested in food?
I'm not trying to lose weight. Just... I don't really care about eating. Not hungry, I guess.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or like you've lost interest or pleasure in things you'd normally enjoy?
Yeah... I guess. Just... most days I wake up with this heavy feeling in my chest. Just empty. Like there ain't nothing good waiting for me anyway... so I just want to keep my head down.
How long have you been feeling this way—this heavy, empty feeling and not caring about things—has it been going on for two weeks or more?
Yeah... a lot longer than two weeks. Just... feels like it's been hanging over me for... I don't know, maybe five months now. Something like that.
Have you noticed that you've lost interest or pleasure in activities or hobbies you used to enjoy?

Yeah... I guess. I used to like walking by the lake... or working on these little model kits I got. But... I don't know. Now they just sit there. I look at 'em and... it's like they belong to somebody else.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or wishing you weren't alive during this time?
No... I ain't gonna do nothing to hurt myself. Just... mostly I just want to stay asleep. That's all.
Before these last five months, had you ever gone through a period like this—feeling this down or empty for weeks at a time—at any earlier point in your life?
I don't know... can't really remember. Maybe? Just... never really thought about it before. I don't think it was ever... like this, though.

Going further back—before these last five months—was there ever a time when you felt completely back to your normal self, with no down or empty feelings, for several months or more, after a period like this?
I ain't really sure. I don't know. Just... I was always just regular before, I guess. I ain't really kept track of months and stuff like that.

Before this current stretch of feeling down started, can you recall ever having a similar period of sadness or low mood in the past that later fully lifted, where you felt like yourself again for at least a couple of months before this recent episode began?
I... ain't you just ask me that? I don't know. I really don't remember nothing like that. Before this... I was just me. I don't really know what else to tell you.

Think back over the last few years—was there ever a stretch of at least two months, at any point before these last five months, when you felt completely normal, with your usual energy and interest in things?
Look... I don't know how else to say it. I ain't got a calendar in my head for all that. I just... I was fine before. Until I wasn't. I don't know about no two months or nothing. I'm just tired.
Have you ever, at any point before these last five months, seen a doctor, counselor, or anyone else because you were feeling really down or not yourself?
Nah... I ain't never went to nobody for that. No doctors or counselors or nothing. Just... never did.
Over these past five months, how has your sleep been—are you having trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?

Sleep's been bad. I just... I lie there for hours. Staring at the wall. Or I wake up way before the sun's even up and can't get back to sleep. And even if I do get some sleep... I just wake up tired anyway. It's just bad.
Over these past five months, have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy, even when you haven't been doing much?

Yeah... just... ain't got no energy. Everything's just... too much. Even just taking out the trash, or... coming here to the clinic. It's hard. Just feels like... like my arms and legs are full of wet sand or something. Just heavy.
Over these past five months, have you been feeling worthless, or blaming yourself for things that aren't really your fault?

Yeah... I guess so. Just... been thinking a lot. About how I ain't no good since I lost that job. Now my family's gotta help me out and... I don't know. I just sit there thinking about every little mistake I made. Like I just ruined everything. It's... yeah.
Over these past five months, have you noticed trouble concentrating, focusing on things, or making decisions, even about small everyday matters?

Yeah... my mind just wanders off. I try to look at bills or... forms they send me, but I just can't focus on 'em. And... I don't know, even at the store, I just stand there. Can't even pick out a can of soup. It's just... hard to decide on anything.

Over these past five months, how much has this been affecting your ability to manage your daily responsibilities—like taking care of yourself, your home, or getting through your day—would you say you can still mostly manage, or has it become very difficult to function at all?

Yeah... it's real hard. I ain't keeping up. Since it got bad, I just... I need my family to help with everything. With money, and... giving me rides. Even just paperwork and stuff. I ain't doing my regular errands no more. Just... can't get to 'em.

During these past five months, have you experienced anything unusual—like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't, or having thoughts or beliefs that others might find strange or hard to believe?
No... ain't nothing like that. I don't hear voices or nothing. Just... my own thoughts. That's all.
